§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 tourism vocabulary to advanced C1 destination strategy and analytics discourse, every module is anchored in real-world tourism scenarios — from guest experience to destination marketing, from sustainable tourism to smart booking platforms. Built for use inside tour operators, hospitality groups, destination marketing organizations, and travel agencies.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from booking platforms, destination campaigns, and hospitality operations in 2026.

02

AI-powered travel planning, smart destination marketing, and predictive booking tools run throughout the program — reflecting today's tourism industry.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Tourism Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international tourism professionals. Gringo reflects his vision: language learning as destination capability — a multiplier of careers, journeys, and influence.

Designed for the destination marketers, hospitality leaders, and travel executives shaping global tourism — Gringo is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to guide travelers in the fastest-growing industry in the world.
